job.title: MR & HR Truck Drivers
job.description:
Our client is a well-established leader in the LPG industry, providing reliable energy solutions to residential, commercial and industrial customers across Australia. With a strong focus on safety, service excellence and operational reliability, they have built a reputation for delivering essential energy products to a diverse range of customers.

Due to sustained business growth, they are seeking experienced MR & HR Truck Drivers and Tanker Drivers to join their team at their Tamworth depot. These opportunities offer ongoing, long-term employment with a supportive team, consistent weekday work and opportunities for training and career progression.

  • $40 per hour
  • Monday to Friday roster
  • Early starts between 4:00 am and 6:00 am
  • 8+ hour shifts
  • Training and development opportunities

About the Role – MR & HR Truck Driver

As an MR or HR Truck Driver, you will be responsible for the safe and efficient delivery of gas cylinders to commercial and residential customers. This is a hands-on role combining driving, customer service and general yard duties.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Completing multi-drop deliveries of gas cylinders
  • Loading and unloading gas cylinders at customer sites
  • Safely handling, filling, sorting and cleaning gas cylinders
  • Completing general yard duties
  • Providing professional and friendly customer service during deliveries
  • Maintaining accurate delivery documentation

About the Role – Tanker Driver

As a Tanker Driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of bulk LPG to commercial customers, including service stations and storage facilities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Transporting and delivering bulk LPG to commercial customers
  • Completing cylinder handling duties, including filling, cleaning, testing and sorting, as required
  • Performing general yard duties as needed
  • Conducting vehicle pre-start checks and reporting maintenance or safety concerns
  • Completing delivery paperwork and maintaining accurate records

Requirements:

  • Previous MR or HR Truck driving experience
  • Current MR or HR truck Licence
  • Dangerous Goods Licence, or a willingness to obtain one
  • Current LF Ticket will be highly regarded
  • Previous multi-drop delivery experience, preferably in a similar industry
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • A good level of physical fitness and the ability to undertake manual handling duties
  • Experience within the LPG, fuel, gas, or dangerous goods will be highly regarded

If you're an experienced HR Driver or Tanker Driver looking for a stable, long-term opportunity with a reputable industry leader, we want to hear from you!

Apply now with your current resume to be considered. Our recruitment team will be in contact with suitable applicants to discuss the opportunities further.

job.title: In Store Florist
job.description:
Our client, a market leader in wholesale floral and potted products, priding themselves on product quality and customer service are seeking to recruit Floral Wrappers/florists with previous experience or training to join our team on a casual basis 3 days per week.

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to work within a retail space who will ensure the highest quality customer service, floral ranges and flower arrangements are provided for the store’s customers. Recent graduates of floristry training encouraged to apply.

Located in Coburg North, duties will include:

  • Wrapping of mixed and single floral bunches (small and large)
  • Bouquet arrangements to customer specification
  • Use of specialised gift-wrapping materials
  • Advising customers on floral selections
  • Merchandising the store to showcase designs and quality
  • Maintaining stock levels
  • Maintaining a safe, clean, and well-organised working and shopping environment and comply with all applicable health and safety procedures and safe work practices.

To be successful, candidates will have the following:

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively unsupervised
  • Certificate 3 in Floristry or equivalent experience
  • Ability to follow instructions and procedures
  • Passion for floral retail
  • Creative flair
  • Effective time management skills
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to visually examine products for quality and freshness
  • Available to work shifts on Friday & Saturday (9am – 5pm) Sunday (10am-2pm),
  • Previous exposure to a retail environment would be advantageous

Applicants will be notified via email and phone if successful for interview selection. Please ensure your application has a current email address and mobile number.
